title: Fix response status check, tabId fallback, and payload buffer decoding
description: Fixes for Voiden host app integration and response handling.

Fixed: Support response.statusCode in onProcessResponse hook to prevent early exit
Fall back to active tab ID via context.tab.getActiveTab() when response.getCurrentTabId() is cleared
Decode Buffer and Uint8Array response bodies before schema inference to prevent byte index field paths

title: Initial release
description: First standalone community release of Schema Drift Detector for Voiden.

Added: Inferred structural schema trees from JSON and XML responses
Breaking change detection (field removals, type mutations, nullability changes)
Non-breaking additions and schema evolution tracking
Ignore rules supporting exact match, wildcards (*.timestamp), and regex
Baseline schema manager with auto-recording and manual pin/lock
Response Panel section with diff metrics, search filter, and visual status badges
Export reports in Markdown, JSON, HTML, and plain text formats
Headless runner for automated CI testing pipelines
